name: xxxHolic ~Watanuki no Izayoi Souwa~
source: The protagonist of the series is Kimihiro Watanuki, a high school student who is constantly haunted by monsters, ghosts and spirits who are magically attracted to him because of his blood. These monsters are invisible to people without power, so other people brand him as weird or crazy when he is haunted by the spirits. Everything changes when he goes into a store that sells wishes.
translation: 本系列主人公四月一日君寻是一名高中生，因为血液的缘故不断被怪物、鬼魂与灵体缠上，它们会受魔法吸引而来。没有力量的人看不见这些怪物，因此其他人会在灵体骚扰他时把他当成怪人或疯子。一切在他走进一家出售愿望的商店后发生改变。
